title.narrative: Senegal Electricity Modernisation Project

description.narrative: The proposed operation will support two of the main pillars of the Governments overall plan for the recovery of the electricity sector, namely: (i) upgrade of the transmission and distribution networks, and (ii) operational turnaround of the Société Nationale dElectricité du Sénégal -SENELEC-.The proposed operation will contribute to economic development by connecting new users (some of whom with low income) in rural areas. It will as well enable to improve the quality and reliability of electricity supply in existing isolated networks. Such actions will contribute to the implementation of the Senegalese Urgency Program for Rural Electrification (Programme d'Urgence d'Electrification Rurale PNUER) of the Senegalese Government.The project involves the construction of 287 km of Medium-Voltage electricity lines spread throughout six electric backbones amongst those identified in the Senegalese Urgency Program for Rural Electrification (PNUER) for the regions of Kolda, Sédhiou et Ziguinchor. Such electricity backbones concern 16 rural communities with their corresponding villages. The purpose is to take advantage of the electric backbones passing through as presented in section A above to electrify some 150 neighbouring villages, c. 55 000 inhabitants (out of a potential of 635 villages and 234 537 inhabitants) located in the surrounding areas (0 to 2 km range) of the lines (installation of derivate lines and a Low-Voltage network along with the actual connections to provide access to electricity). The villages concerned will be identified in the context of the Feasibility Studies
